rules.title: 2026 Relocation Assistance Payments
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay tenants a standard relocation assistance payment of $19,413, plus an additional $6,471 for qualifying households, in the event of an owner move-in eviction or an Ellis Act eviction.

coverage.summary: Applies to units subject to owner move-in or Ellis Act evictions under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and Ellis Implementation Ordinance.
coverage.unresolvable: Relocation requirements apply specifically to owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions.

rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to $19,413. The additional relocation assistance payment for qualifying households will increase to $6,471.
